summary: @c1-ease/card exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded VPS on install and import
details: The package declares `postinstall: node beacon.cjs`, and beacon.cjs POSTs the installer's hostname, install path, cwd, and node version to a hardcoded endpoint at https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc over HTTPS with TLS certificate verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false). The same beacon is invoked from index.js, so it also fires on `require('@c1-ease/card')`. The package's advertised functionality is absent: index.js exports a Proxy returning no-op functions, and the description claims only a 'Compatibility shim'. The scoped name `@c1-ease/card` combined with a stub implementation plus an install/import-time beacon to an unaffiliated bare-VPS host is consistent with a dependency-confusion payload that identifies victim machines that resolve this name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
